title: Check if a number is even
description: Write a function `is_even(n)` that returns whether `n` is even, using the modulus operator.
hints: n % 2 gives the remainder of dividing n by 2 - a number is even exactly when that remainder is 0.
expected_behavior: Returns True if n is even, False otherwise.
explanation: The modulus operator is the direct translation of 'divisible by 2, remainder zero' - no need to check n / 2 for a whole number instead.
